statement: RISC Zero guest pca-zkvm-guest for PCA 0.4.2 (guest_version 8): root caveats outside the envelope and max_spend (0.4.1 fix), the Intent Layer M2 intent binding, Intent Layer v2 rules 13-19 (schema, intent_session with revocation, V5 layers, accumulators with receipt / key-set freshness and equivocation, the V15 committed-map check with the disclosure as a private input, W-B facts / provenance / classes), and every signature suite but LESS (ML-DSA, SLH-DSA, hybrids, FN-DSA); journal = fixtures/proof_run/journal.json
guest_elf_note: ELF not committed (gitignored); Cargo.lock files pin the dependency graph. The image id above is the authoritative identity.

versions.host rustc: stable (rust-toolchain.toml) as installed by rustup on the box
versions.groth16 prover docker image: risczero/risc0-groth16-prover (tag per risc0-zkvm 3.0.6 default, pulled by the host); docker.io from Ubuntu 24.04

host.cloud: GCP (PCA cloud farm box gcp, via the pcaq job queue, exclusive)

reproduce: bash sdks/zkvm-pca/host/box-prove.sh <out-dir> on an x86_64 Linux box (installs rzup rust 1.97.0 + r0vm 3.0.6 and docker.io when missing)

pipeline.step: groth16 wrap (stark-to-snark) of that succinct receipt

pipeline.where: same run (execute + full proving attempt per variant)
pipeline.result: 55 of 55 variants: guest panicked, no receipt
